PC01-X01.name: Drian-the-Shooting-Star
PC01-X01.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Azure Contract/Incarnate & C5 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

When your Attack Step/Turn would end due to opposing effects, you can [Contract Advent] this card from the Hand onto "Ian".

[LV1][LV2] (Your Turn)
The opponent can't end Turn/Attack Step via effects.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Cost 10 or less Spirit/Ultimate. Then, by exhausting a Nexus you control, refresh up to two "Incarnate" family Spirits/Ultimates you control.

PC01-001.name: The Ruins of the Hill Where Shooting Stars Fall
PC01-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
The opponent can't use Magic cards which don't have the same colors as the symbols on their Field. Also, while you have five or more counters, the opponent can't use [Accel] which don't have the same colors as the symbols on their Field.

[LV2] (Start of Your Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) You can pay one cost to summon an "Incarnate" family pre-advent card under your Spirit.

PC01-CX01.name: Ian (Card)
PC01-CX01.effect:
While this card is in Soul State, you can [Contract Advent] onto it. When you do, you can put any number of cores from your Field/Reserve to the advent card.

[Soul State][Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2]
(Once per turn: Same Name) When your counter increases via your "Incarnate" family effects, you can put a core from the Void to any of your "Incarnate" family Spirits.

[Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Your counters +2. Then, ignoring the cost of Braves, destroy an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit/Ultimate.
